heading.en: Settling the past before the partner leaves
heading.kn: ಪಾಲುದಾರ ಹೊರಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಚುಕ್ತಾ

hook.en: The firm's land has doubled in value while the retiring partner was with the firm. He deserves his share of that gain before he goes.
hook.kn: ನಿವೃತ್ತ ಪಾಲುದಾರ ಇದ್ದಾಗಲೇ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಭೂಮಿಯ ಬೆಲೆ ದ್ವಿಗುಣವಾಗಿದೆ. ಹೊರಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಆ ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪಾಲು ಸಿಗಬೇಕು.

objectives.en: Prepare the Revaluation Account on retirement

narration.en: The firm's land has doubled in value while the retiring partner was with the firm. He deserves his share of that gain before he goes. So we revalue assets and liabilities and distribute reserves among all partners.
narration.kn: ನಿವೃತ್ತ ಪಾಲುದಾರ ಇದ್ದಾಗಲೇ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಭೂಮಿಯ ಬೆಲೆ ದ್ವಿಗುಣವಾಗಿದೆ. ಹೊರಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಆ ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪಾಲು ಸಿಗಬೇಕು. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಹೊಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡಿ ಮೀಸಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಹಂಚುತ್ತೇವೆ.

body.en: The Revaluation Account is prepared exactly as on admission. Its profit or loss is shared by all partners, including the retiring partner, in the old ratio, because the change in values took place while he was a partner.
body.kn: ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಖಾತೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರವೇಶದಂತೆಯೇ ತಯಾರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ಲಾಭ ಅಥವಾ ನಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ನಿವೃತ್ತನೂ ಸೇರಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಾಲುದಾರರು ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.

narration.en: The Revaluation Account is prepared exactly as on admission. Its profit or loss is shared by all partners, including the retiring partner, in the old ratio, because the change in values took place while he was a partner.
narration.kn: ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಖಾತೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರವೇಶದಂತೆಯೇ ತಯಾರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ಲಾಭ ಅಥವಾ ನಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ನಿವೃತ್ತನೂ ಸೇರಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಾಲುದಾರರು ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title.en: Reserves and accumulated profits or losses

body.en: General reserve, credit balance of Profit and Loss Account and similar accumulated profits are credited to all partners in the old ratio. Debit balance of Profit and Loss Account and deferred revenue expenditure are debited to all partners in the old ratio.
body.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮೀಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಚಿತ ಲಾಭಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಮಾ. ಸಂಚಿತ ನಷ್ಟಗಳು ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಖರ್ಚು.

narration.en: General reserve, credit balance of Profit and Loss Account and similar accumulated profits are credited to all partners in the old ratio. Debit balance of Profit and Loss Account and deferred revenue expenditure are debited to all partners in the old ratio.
narration.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮೀಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಚಿತ ಲಾಭಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಮಾ. ಸಂಚಿತ ನಷ್ಟಗಳು ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಖರ್ಚು.

problem.en: A, B and C share 2:2:1. C retires. Building is appreciated by ₹20,000, machinery depreciated by ₹5,000 and provision for doubtful debts increased by ₹1,000. General Reserve is ₹25,000. Find each partner's share of the revaluation result and C's total credit from these items.

answer.en: A ₹5,600, B ₹5,600, C ₹2,800; C is credited ₹7,800 in all

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A, B and C share 2:2:1. C retires. Building is appreciated by ₹20,000, machinery depreciated by ₹5,000 and provision for doubtful debts increased by ₹1,000. General Reserve is ₹25,000. Find each partner's share of the revaluation result and C's total credit from these items.

body.en: On admission the new partner stays out of revaluation and reserves. On retirement nobody stays out — all partners, old ratio.

narration.en: Retirement: everyone shares the past. On admission the new partner stays out of revaluation and reserves. On retirement nobody stays out — all partners, old ratio.

mnemonic.en: Past belongs to those who were there

narration.en: Roll call quiz. When your roll number is called, give your answer.
narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಾತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕ್ರಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

points.en: Revaluation profit or loss is shared by all partners in the old ratio.
points.kn: ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನದ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ.

points.en: Reserves are credited and accumulated losses debited in the old ratio.
points.kn: ಮೀಸಲು ಜಮಾ, ಸಂಚಿತ ನಷ್ಟ ಖರ್ಚು — ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ.

points.en: The retiring partner gets his share of both.

homework.en: Prepare the Revaluation Account for the worked example.

narration.en: Recap. Revaluation profit or loss is shared by all partners in the old ratio. Reserves are credited and accumulated losses debited in the old ratio. The retiring partner gets his share of both.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನದ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ. ಮೀಸಲು ಜಮಾ, ಸಂಚಿತ ನಷ್ಟ ಖರ್ಚು — ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ. ನಿವೃತ್ತನಿಗೂ ಎರಡರಲ್ಲೂ ಪಾಲು.
